questions.stem: Why is cleanliness of hydraulic oil so important?
options: Dirt wears and jams valves, pumps and cylinders
questions.explanation: Contamination is the main cause of hydraulic failures.

questions.stem: Air in a hydraulic system typically causes:
options: Noise, spongy control and erratic movement
questions.explanation: Bleed the system and find the leak.

questions.stem: The safest way to look for a pinhole hydraulic leak is to:
options: Put your face close to it
Run your bare hand along the hose
Pass a piece of cardboard near it with the system de-pressurised where possible, never your hand
questions.explanation: High-pressure fluid can penetrate skin and cause serious injury.

questions.stem: A hydraulic cylinder has a piston area of 0.002 square metres and works at 8 MPa. The force it can produce is:
questions.explanation: Force = pressure x area = 8 000 000 Pa x 0.002 m2 = 16 000 N, which is 16 kN.

questions.stem: In a hydraulic circuit, pressure is created when:
options: The pump spins faster than the motor
The flow from the pump meets resistance
questions.explanation: A pump supplies flow. Pressure builds only when the oil is resisted, for example by a load on a cylinder.

questions.stem: The relief valve in a hydraulic system:
options: Opens at a set pressure and returns oil to the tank to protect the system
Filters fine particles from the oil
questions.explanation: It prevents over-pressure damage. It must not be adjusted without authority.

questions.stem: The part of a hydraulic circuit that gives straight-line push or pull is the:
questions.explanation: A motor gives rotation. The control valve only directs the oil.

options: Decides which side of the actuator the oil is sent to, so which way it moves
questions.explanation: Moving the valve changes the flow path and so the direction of the actuator.

questions.stem: A hydraulic system contains an accumulator. Before a hose is disconnected you should:
options: Assume it is empty when the pump has stopped
Isolate and lock out the power, and relieve the stored pressure using the maker's procedure
Loosen the hose slowly with the system running
Heat the line to release the pressure
questions.explanation: An accumulator stays charged after the pump stops and can spray oil at high pressure.
